card.name: Inside long medical words in capitals
card.fires_on: Partway through long medical terms written in ALL CAPS, in warning headings and section titles. It fires on the piece just before the word's next syllable, e.g. MULT<<IF>>OCAL, T<<END>>ON.

modes.label: Disease names in caps
modes.description: Middle piece of a split disease or condition name in an all-caps warning.

modes.label: Drug or therapy names in caps
modes.description: Middle piece of a drug or treatment word in capitals.
modes.example: ASPIRIN AND OTHER SAL<<ICY>>LATE DRUGS WILL BE ADD

card.writes: It seems to push the next piece of the word to start with a short vowel-plus-consonant such as il, ir, im or ik.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of long medical words printed in capital letters, such as in boxed warnings.
